name: Needle Gust
description: Squeeze a gust to a needle at the fingertip and prick it into one joint of the target.

name: Narrow Step
description: Slip along a thin lane of air between two foes without brushing either of them.

name: Slim Guard
description: Hold a narrow blade of air edge-on to the line of a thrust and turn the point aside.

name: Thread Touch
description: Run a single fine thread of air outward and feel each place where it brushes a hidden body.

name: Pinprick Draft
description: Drive a thin pin of air into a foe's wrist so the grip loosens and the weapon sags.

name: Narrowing Breath
description: Narrow the breath to a thin steady stream and bind qi to it so the user's aim steadies.

name: Fine Shear
description: Cut a hairline shear of air through cloth and padding to reach the skin beneath.

name: Piercing Zephyr
description: Compress a whole breeze into a boring spear of air that punches through a raised guard and the arm behind it.

name: Needle Squall
description: Fire a fan of needle-fine air at the target's limbs so that each pin binds a joint and slows its movement.

name: Ring Cover
description: Set a ring of turning air about the body so that glancing blows lose speed as they slide round it.

name: Twirl Cover
description: Twirl the forearms to spin the air before the chest and spin a missile off its line.

name: Swirl Fist
description: Close the fist inside a swirl of air and strike with the spinning force riding the knuckles.

name: Gyre Slip
description: Trace a half circle on a gyre of air and finish a pace behind the attacker.

name: Dust Sense
description: Read the shape of a moving foe from the dust and grit its passage lifts into the air.

name: Wheel Shield
description: Turn a broad wheel of air before the body that stops weak blows and spins strong ones wide.

name: Counter Zephyr
description: Catch the foe's strike in a curl of air and shove the hitting arm back with its own weight.

name: Settled Lungs
description: Settle the breath after a blow so the user's heart steadies and the guard is rebuilt at once.

name: Whirlwind Mantle
description: Wrap the whole body in a rotating mantle of wind that breaks strikes and flings small missiles away.

name: Cyclone Return
description: Take a heavy blow into the mantle and spin it round to throw its force back at the striker.

name: Sky Palm
description: Reach with the palm and let the qi field carry the blow to a target just beyond arm's length.

name: Constant Draft
description: Let the qi field run as a steady draft round the body and blunt strikes before they land.

name: Open Step
description: Step along a lane of air thrown ahead by the qi field and arrive in one long stride.

name: Sky Read
description: Read every disturbance in the surrounding air and mark its distance and speed.

name: Wide Breath
description: Take a very wide breath and let the qi field fill with it so the user's reach grows briefly.

name: Spreading Gust
description: Throw the field outward in one broad gust that jolts every foe inside its spread.

name: Listening Wind
description: Stretch the field outward and read the position of every living thing it passes over.

name: Sky Cut
description: Cut a long blade of air from the field and send it flying at a distant target.

name: Boundless Draft
description: Let the qi field flow outward without limit and sense each approach while it shields the user from missiles.

name: Skysweep Gale
description: Sweep the whole field round in a single arc and strike every foe within its reach with a roaring gale.

name: Gentle Updraft
description: Lift a tired ally's chest with a slow draft so each breath comes easier for some moments.

name: Breath Share
description: Pass a measured breath of qi to an ally through the air between them to steady a panting chest.

name: Chest Draft
description: Hold a soft draft before the ribs to cushion blows aimed at the breath and heart.

name: Quiet Pace
description: Move to a fallen ally's side on a soft draft that sets no dust or noise astir.

name: Chest Feel
description: Feel the rise and fall of air in an ally's chest and judge how weak the breath has become.

name: Air Stir
description: Stir the air sharply about a foe's face to break its aim and draw its eyes away.

name: Smoke Draw
description: Draw smoke and choking fume out of an ally's lungs on a steady current of clean air.

name: Clean Breeze
description: Blow a clean breeze over a poisoned ally to carry off a light taint from skin and breath.

name: Lung Clear
description: Pull water or ash out of a choking ally's chest with a sharp inward draft of air.

name: Breath Restored
description: Drive qi and air into the chest of an ally whose breath just stopped and restart the lungs inside a short window.

name: Breath Renewal
description: Wake a collapsed ally whose breath has failed by pumping the chest with air then lending steadying qi.

name: Pair Gust
description: Strike with one palm and follow at once with the other so a second gust lands on the first.

name: Pair Draft
description: Kick two drafts from the heels in turn and cross a short gap in two quick bounds.

name: Paired Screen
description: Hold two screens of air one behind the other so a blow that breaks the first dies in the second.

name: Counter Breath
description: Breathe out as the foe breathes in and so steal the first beat of the exchange for the user.

name: Pair Listen
description: Listen with both ears to the way two drafts differ and so locate the sound that moves between them.

name: Paired Cut
description: Loose two blades of air one after the other at the same spot on the target.

name: Crossing Gusts
description: Cross two gusts at the foe's chest so they meet and burst and rock the stance.

name: Level Lungs
description: Hold the breath in even beats and let the qi follow it so the user's strikes stay in time.

name: Crossing Gale
description: Drive two gales across each other above the foes so they burst together in a heavy gust.

name: Paired Squall
description: Throw a squall from each hand while springing aside so both hit as the user lands.

name: Bright Palm
description: Strike with a straight palm and a clean crack of air that marks the blow as a warning.

name: Clear Parry
description: Hold a firm upright guard and sweep the foe's hand aside with a crisp stroke of air.

name: High Step
description: Rise on a lifting draft and step across a low obstacle with the back kept straight.

name: Calm Sense
description: Still the air about the body and judge the mood and weight of those who approach.

name: Poised Breath
description: Hold the breath poised at the top and let the qi gather so the next stroke is exact.

name: Stern Gust
description: Strike with a hard flat gust that knocks the foe's chin up and ruins its balance.

name: Rebuke Draft
description: Answer an overreaching blow by sweeping it wide and cracking a draft across the foe's face.

name: Counted Inhale
description: Count each breath against each step so that qi and motion move in measure for the user.

name: Judging Gale
description: Bring down a single exact gale on the foe's guard arm that crushes it and holds it low.

name: Lofty Squall
description: Call a squall down from above that strikes each foe in a circle about the user from over their heads.

name: Track Palm
description: Strike along one line of air while the other hand holds a guard on the second line.

name: Track Slide
description: Slide along a line of air thrown before the feet and shift to the second line at will.

name: Track Cover
description: Hold one screen of air in front and one on the flank so that two angles are guarded.

name: Dual Sense
description: Read the air in front and behind at the same moment and fix the place where they differ.

name: Running Gust
description: Run on one track of wind and fire a gust along the other at the foe as the user passes.

name: Guarded Rush
description: Charge behind a moving screen of air that takes the first blows of the defenders.

name: Track Cadence
description: Breathe on two rhythms at once so the user's attack and guard keep their own steady speed.

name: Dual Tempest
description: Raise a storm on each side of the body that strikes the foes in its path and screens the user.

name: Parallel Zephyr
description: Rush forward on one zephyr while a second flies beside and strikes the target as the user arrives.

name: Wind Heading
description: Set a heading by the wind and take one firm step along it without drifting off the line.

name: Set Bearing
description: Take the direction of the prevailing wind and hold it as a fixed mark against any confusion.

name: Steady Palm
description: Hold the stance still on its bearing and drive the palm out with a flat steady gust.

name: Oath Screen
description: Plant the feet and hold an unmoving guard of air that the wind-sworn do not yield.

name: Bound Draft
description: Bind a foe's front foot with a fast loop of air so it cannot yield ground.

name: Sworn Breath
description: Speak the oath on a held breath and let the qi settle firmly into the user's limbs.

name: Held Gust
description: Hold a gust against the foe's chest and keep it there so the foe cannot advance a pace.

name: True Heading
description: Read the wind for a true heading and advance along it even when the eyes are blind.

name: Oath Blow
description: Strike along the sworn heading with the whole body behind the gust and no turn to either side.

name: Bearing Gale
description: Hurl the body down the held bearing on a hard gale and strike through the foe in the line.

name: Unbroken Draft
description: Keep one steady draft round the body without a break so no strike finds a gap to enter.

name: Open Gust
description: Throw the open hand forward and let a wide gust meet the target in the open.

name: Free Pace
description: Take an unhindered step on a free draft that leaves the user's footing light and loose.

name: Bare Parry
description: Meet a blow with the bare forearm and turn it with a thin skin of air alone.

name: Oath Listening
description: Hold the oath of the open air and let the wind tell the user where foes hide.

name: Idle Breath
description: Breathe freely and fully and let qi flow loosely through the user's whole frame.

name: Wide Gust
description: Spread a wide gust in front of the user that pushes every foe in its width back a pace.

name: Free Run
description: Run straight at the foe on an open draft with no cover taken and no pace lost.

name: Clean Gale
description: Blow a gale through the field to sweep poison and smoke and light taint off allies in it.

name: Sworn Squall
description: Break a squall across the open field that strikes foes and ruins their formations and cover.

name: Unbound Breath
description: Loose every held breath and let qi run free so the user and an ally move faster in the field.

name: Roaming Palm
description: Strike from a roaming stance and let the palm follow the wind wherever the target shifts.

name: Loose Draft
description: Kick a loose draft behind the heel and let it carry the user a long step sideways.

name: Open Cover
description: Hold a thin cover of air overhead that takes thrown stones and falling debris from above.

name: Distant Sense
description: Send the sense out on the wind to learn what moves far off before it arrives.

name: Rolling Breath
description: Roll the breath from belly to chest in one smooth wave and carry qi to the limbs.

name: Rolling Gale
description: Roll a long gale across the ground that sweeps foes off their feet as it passes.

name: Sweeping Draft
description: Sweep a flat draft along the floor to scatter caltrops and foes' footing alike.

name: Wind Scour
description: Scour a patch of ground and air with a strong wind that lifts away lingering poison and taint.

name: Scouring Gale
description: Drive an open gale across the whole field that scours foes and cover bare in a single sweep.

name: Unwalled Squall
description: Ride a rolling squall through the field and strike each foe it crosses without halting its path.
